headline_seed: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones - NPR
draft_text:
Trump announced Sunday he would convert his planned 250-foot D.C. arch into a military complex housing drones and snipers, citing the military's request. The Pentagon declined to comment. NPR and NBC News both confirm no cost or timeline was provided.

And that's the mews.
